# 1. Charter Sovereign Central Bank (one-time per country)
oe_fin_dec_charter_central_bank = {
	decision_category = economy_decisions
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		is_subject = no
		current_year >= 1660
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_fin_central_bank_chartered }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_fin_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		gold >= 250
		stability >= 0
		is_during_bankruptcy = no
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = regular 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:crown_estate background = estate_type:burghers_estate } }
	option = {
		name = oe_fin_dec_charter_central_bank.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_fin_dec_charter_central_bank_tt
			oe_fin_init_host = yes
			add_gold = -250
			set_variable = { name = oe_fin_central_bank_chartered value = 1 }
			oe_fin_add_bubble_heat = { amt = -18 }
			oe_fin_bump_stabilization = { amt = 1 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_fin_mod_central_bank_charter years = 40 mode = replace }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_fin_ev_109 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_fin_ev_109 value = 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_fin.109
			}
		}
	}
}
